title: Data-Free Transition-Spectrum Winsorization for Mamba Long-Context Generalization

contributions.purpose: Extend Mamba's long-context generalization without needing calibration data.
contributions.mechanism: Transition-spectrum winsorization clips only extreme eigenvalues (outside the [q, 1-q] percentile range) in each layer's transition spectrum while preserving the mid-spectrum.
contributions.evaluation: On PG-19 with Mamba2-1.3B achieves PPL@64K of 11.44, 13% better than constant scaling (13.19), without calibration data (calibrated scaling reaches 4.72 but needs data).
contributions.domain: Long-context extension of Mamba / state space models.
contributions.source_quote: A data-free method for Mamba long-context extension via transition-spectrum winsorization, achieving PPL@64K of 11.44 (13% better than constant scaling) without requiring calibration data.

contributions.purpose: Show targeted clipping beats uniform scaling.
contributions.mechanism: Compares winsorization of extreme eigenvalues (modifying 17.5% of channels) against uniform constant scaling (100% of channels).
contributions.evaluation: Targeted clipping outperforms uniform scaling with lower short-context regression (+6.8% vs +20.8%).
contributions.domain: Long-context extension of Mamba / state space models.
contributions.source_quote: Empirical demonstration that targeted clipping of extreme eigenvalues (17.5% of channels) outperforms uniform scaling (100% of channels), with lower short-context regression (+6.8% vs +20.8%).

contributions.purpose: Explain the origin of the extreme eigenvalues.
contributions.mechanism: Mechanism analysis attributing extreme effective eigenvalues to input-dependent delta_t dynamics rather than static A-matrix outliers.
contributions.evaluation: Qualitative mechanistic finding motivating future input-dependent interventions.
contributions.domain: Long-context extension of Mamba / state space models.
contributions.source_quote: Mechanism analysis revealing that extreme effective eigenvalues are driven by input-dependent Delta_t dynamics rather than static A outliers, motivating future work on input-dependent interventions.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Mamba Modulation (Lu et al., 2025) connected length generalization to the spectrum of the transition matrix and proposed spectrum scaling to enable robust long-context performance. Our work differs by proposing a data-free approach that clips extreme eigenvalues without requiring calibration data.

Prior work has addressed this through calibrated scaling (Lu et al., 2025), which determines optimal per-layer scaling factors via forward passes on representative data... this approach requires calibration data that may not always be available.
